title: Ambient ideal-power extension from a closed structure module
statement: Let $X$ be a Noetherian scheme [pqf-def-locnoeth] and $i:W\to X$ a closed immersion [def-weil-closed-immersion]. Let $I\subseteq\mathcal O_X$ be a quasi-coherent ideal sheaf [def-sbc-closed-immersion-ideal-sheaf], $G$ a coherent $\mathcal O_X$-module [pqf-def-coherent], and $U\subseteq X$ an open whose complement is the support $V(I)$. Put $H=i_*\mathcal O_W$ [def-pc-module-pullback]. For every morphism $\varphi:H|_U\to G|_U$ there exist $n\geq0$ and $\chi:I^nH\to G$ such that $\chi|_U=(I^nH\hookrightarrow H)|_U$ followed by $\varphi$, where the power is the ideal-sheaf-data power and the product is the image of multiplication [lem-weil-pbc-ideal-module-product-stalk]. No integrality, generic point, or nonzero ideal on $W$ is asserted.

source.place: Tag 01YB (lemma-homs-over-open), with Tags 01XZ and 01QY; source and target specialized to the closed structure pushforward and a coherent module.

proof.text: The structure module on W is invertible, hence finitely presented, quasi-coherent and finite type. A closed immersion is finite. Finite pushforward gives quasi-coherence and finite type of H = i_* O_W. The locally Noetherian coherence criterion makes H coherent and makes the given coherent G quasi-coherent.
Apply the tensor-extension theorem to H, G, I, the specified U, and phi. Obtain n and beta : (I^n).toModules tensor H -> G with the restriction equation.
Apply the tensor-image lift theorem at n to obtain m and a : I^(n+m) H -> I^n tensor H whose multiplication composite is the inclusion.
Set chi = a followed by beta. Functor.map_comp, the beta restriction equation, associativity, and the equation for a give the required equality at exponent n+m.

proof_origin.place: Tag 01YB, tensor extension followed by the second Artin-Rees image descent; finite pushforward and Tag 01XZ for source coherence. Written by X3, 2026-10-13. The original CoherentHomsOverOpen import is cyclic via higher direct images.

lean.statement:
theorem closed_structure_ambient_ideal_extension
    {X W : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian X]
    (i : W ⟶ X) [IsClosedImmersion i]
    (I : X.IdealSheafData) (G : X.Modules)
    (hG : RingedSpace.IsCoherent X.toRingedSpace G)
    (U : X.Opens) (hI : (I.support : Set X) = (U : Set X)ᶜ)
    (φ : (restrictFunctor U.ι).obj
        ((pushforward i).obj (SheafOfModules.unit W.ringCatSheaf)) ⟶
      (restrictFunctor U.ι).obj G) :
    ∃ (n : ℕ) (χ : idealModuleProduct (I ^ n).toModulesι
        ((pushforward i).obj (SheafOfModules.unit W.ringCatSheaf)) ⟶ G),
      (restrictFunctor U.ι).map χ =
        (restrictFunctor U.ι).map (idealModuleProductι (I ^ n).toModulesι
          ((pushforward i).obj (SheafOfModules.unit W.ringCatSheaf))) ≫ φ
